items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Greater)
items.description:
Activate A Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 3d8 fire damage, 3 persistent fire damage, and 3 fire splash damage. You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Scimitar
items.description: This one-handed curved blade is sharp on one side.

items.name: Shield Boss
items.description: Typically a round, convex, or conical piece of thick metal attached to the center of a shield, a shield boss increases the bludgeoning damage of a shield bash.

items.name: Bracers of Armor I
items.description: These stiff leather armguards grant you a +1 item bonus to AC and saving throws, and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5. You can affix talismans to bracers of armor as though they were light armor.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shield Block
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster has its shield raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The monster snaps its shield into place to deflect a blow. The shield prevents the monster from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. The monster and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Draw
offensiveAbilities.description: The battle dancer Interacts to draw a weapon and Strikes with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shield Drum
offensiveAbilities.description: The battle dancer Raises a Shield, then Demoralizes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Threatening Dance
offensiveAbilities.description:
The battle dancer either Steps and then Performs, or Performs and then Steps. Compare the Performance result to the Will DC of one creature in the battle dancer's reach.

Critical Success The creature is Off-Guard to all attacks until the start of the battle dancer's next turn.

Success The creature is off-guard to the next attack by a creature other than the battle dancer before the start of the battle dancer's next turn.
